title: PDTD Scan Output — Schema v2
description: Machine-readable output of pdtd scan --json. Frozen at schema version 2. Never changed without a MAJOR CLI version bump.

schemaVersion.description: Schema contract version. Always '2' for this file.

pdtdVersion.description: SemVer of the pdtd CLI that produced this output.

engineVersion.description: Analysis engine version. v1 = AST+heuristics; v2 = v1 plus industry-aware specificity scoring, reported only when --industry is supplied.

rulesVersion.description: Rule set version used during the scan.

detectedLang.description: Language detected in the project content.

industry.description: Canonical industry id the scan was scored against, or null when --industry was not supplied.

industrySignals.description: Breakdown of the industry vocabulary match, or null when --industry was not supplied.

matchedTerms.description: Distinct lexicon terms found, in lexicon declaration order.

matchedCategories.description: Lexicon categories with at least one match.

adjustment.description: Signed total applied to businessSpecificity, base plus breadth bonus.

aiSmell.description: How much the site matches generic AI-generated landing-page patterns. Higher = more generic.

businessSpecificity.description: How specific the site is to its actual business. Higher = more specific. Includes the industry adjustment when industry is non-null.

humanity.description: Presence of real, verifiable elements (names, credentials, prices). Higher = more real.

issues.description: List of detected issues, one per rule that fired.

ruleId.description: Stable rule identifier (e.g. 'C01'). Never changes within a rules version.

evidence.description: Excerpts or class names that triggered the rule.

location.description: File path relative to the scanned root, always with forward slashes, identical on every platform.
